description:
Defeat Invasion of Alara, triggering it, causing you to exile it and cast Awaken the Maelstorm without paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Awaken the Maelstrom twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Awaken the Maelstrom spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.name: Echo Mage
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

uses.name: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom
uses.cardState: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Alara.
